text:
Actum in Conin Feria Secunda post Dominicam Laetare Quadragesimalem proxima Die Scilicet Trigesima Mensis Martii Anno Domini 1778uo
Ex parte M. Prusimski contra MM. Chełmski et Judicium Terrestre Calissien~ ad Tribunal Relatio
Ad officium et Acta praesentia Castrensia Coninensia personaliter venientes Providi Bartholomaus Szepczyński de villa Trąmpczyn et Mathaus Matuszkiewicz de villa Szetlewek, Ministeriales Regni Generales Sani existentes Recognoverunt se Citt~ Litt~ Authen~ pro Judiciis Ordinariis Generalibus Tribunalis Regni Petricoviensi Infrascripto editt~ binas tenoris talis, Stanislaus Augustus Dei Gratia Rex Poloniae M D Litha~ Ruszia Prussia M. S. Kijoviae Podoliae Podlackiae L. S. Severiae Czerniechoviae Vobis Magnificis Stanislao Chełmski Bonorum Łukomia Haeredi atque Francisco Wierusz Walknowski Judici Stephano Zielonacki Subjudici Xaverio Mikorski Notario Terrestribus Calissiens[i?] Causae Infrascriptae Judicibus Gravaminosis De persona bonis ac Officio Vestris mandamus ut in Judiciis Nostris Ordinariis Tribunalis Regni Petricoviens[i?] a data et positione praesentis Citt~ recte in quatuor Septimanis seu tam diu et quando Causa praesens ex Regro et Inscriptione sibi Competenti adjudicandum vocata et acclamata Incident personaliter et peremptorie Compareatis, ad Instantiam Magnifici Antonii a Kolno Prusimski Capitanei Nieszczevicen[si?] Bonorum Trąmpczyna Haeredis Acto~ Qui vos inhaerendo Manifestationi suae factae sive faciendae tam Legibus Regni et Decretis tam Anterioris Judicii Vestri remissionis ad Terminum Condescensionis Consuccessionem Relictae olim Patrui Acto~ factae atque Tribunali ac Commissioni à Statibus Regni Emanatae Citat, seu potius ad praemissa sistendo Executionem Decreti vestri posterioris Feria 2da post Festum Sanctae Haedvigis viduae Electae Dei scilicet Die 20 8bris, anno praeterito Inter M. Chełmski et se Acto~ in Conin prolati ad citat ad viden[?] et audien[?] Decretum suprafatum Terrestre Coninen~ in Contrarium priori, non relevato nec resoluto priori Decreto uti Etiam absque Termino per Magnificum Chełmski non habito resolvi, nequeunte, ac non attentis Decret~ Tribunalio et Commissione a Statibus Regni Emanata, Forum Terrestre Calissiensi et Decisionem Vestram Impedientibus et non admittentibus gravaminose et etiam non demandata Communicatione Documentorum in tam inveterata Causa et a Triginta Annis initiata, ex praescripto novellae Legis decerni debita prolatum relevan~ a nexuque et rigore ejus se Actorem Liberari Imo Causam pro resolutione ejusdem Decreti, ad Tribunal Remitti, Nihilominus Cassata Transfusione seu Jure illegali per M Chełmski a Famato Joanne Tracholz indebite et in meram vexam ac in Involutionem Causae Granicialis Decreti Actu Commissionalis Discrepantis quaesito in Competen~ Eidem Actione Decreta se Acto ab Impetione hac liberari, ra~one vero Exportati ejusdem Decreti Gravaminosi paenas super parte quam super Judicio exteriori in reliquo ea omnia quae Juris Justitiae ac Documentorum erunt, Contra vos Statui decerni et Sententiari Cittationi sitis parituri et Judicialiter responsuri Dato Petricoviae Sabbato post Dominicam Reminiscere Quadragesimalem Anno Domini 1778uo Primam et quidem Providus Szepczyński in oppido Konin Domoque Famatis Palszewicz [...] praesente matre familia[s?] alteram P Matuszkiewicz contra M Chełmski in Curia Bonorum villae Łukom Praesente [...] Cop[?] utras[?] super mensis hippocaustorum distinctim die hodierna Actu Contenta posuisse et reliquisse

translation.en:
Done at Konin on the Monday next after Laetare Sunday, namely 30 March 1778.

On behalf of the Honourable Prusimski against the Honourables Chełmski and the Kalisz Land Court — to the Tribunal — Relatio

To the office and present records of the Konin Municipal Court, appearing in person, the Honest Bartłomiej Szepczyński of the village of Trąbczyn and Mateusz Matuszkiewicz of the village of Szetlewek, Royal Court Summoners, General, sound of health, acknowledged the two authenticated citation letters issued for the ordinary general sessions of the Crown Tribunal of the Realm at Piotrków as described below, of the following tenor:

Stanislaus Augustus, by the Grace of God King of Poland, Grand Duke of Lithuania, of Russia, of Prussia, of Masovia, of Samogitia, of Kiev, et cetera, of Podolia, of Podlachia, of Livonia, of Smolensk, of Seversk, of Chernigov — to you, the Honourables: Stanisław Chełmski, hereditary owner of the estates of Łukomia; and Franciszek Wierusz Walknowski, Judge; Stefan Zielonacki, Deputy Judge; and Xawery Mikorski, Notary of the Kalisz Land Court — the judges complained of in the cause described below: regarding your persons, goods and office we command that in our Ordinary Courts of the Crown Tribunal of the Realm at Piotrków, from the date and service of the present citation, correctly within four weeks, or for as long as and whenever the present cause shall fall to be called and proclaimed for adjudication from the register and inscription belonging to it, you appear in person and peremptorily, at the instance of the Honourable Antoni of Kolno Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, hereditary owner of the estates of Trąbczyn, plaintiff;

who, adhering to his manifest made or to be made — and to the laws of the Realm and to the decrees both of the prior decree of your court of remission to the condescension term together with the succession of the widow of the plaintiff's late uncle, and to the Tribunal and to the Commission issued by the Estates of the Realm — cites you; or rather, staying the execution of your subsequent decree — issued at Konin on the Monday after the Feast of Saint Hedwig, Widow and Chosen of God, namely 20 October of the preceding year, between the Honourable Chełmski and himself the plaintiff — cites you to see and hear that the above-mentioned Konin Land Court decree, contrary to the prior decree — the prior decree neither reviewed nor resolved, and likewise unable to be resolved without a term which the Honourable Chełmski has not obtained — and with the Tribunal decree and the Commission issued by the Estates of the Realm, which obstruct and do not admit the Kalisz Land Court forum and your decision, not being attended to — having been issued prejudicially and also without the communication of documents due to be decreed according to the new statute of the law in so long-standing a cause begun thirty years ago — be reviewed; himself the plaintiff to be freed from its bond and rigour; nay rather, the cause for the resolution of that same decree to be remitted to the Tribunal;

and nonetheless — the transfer, or right, unlawfully acquired by the Honourable Chełmski from the Honest Jan Tracholz, unduly and for mere vexation and to entangle the boundary cause and the discrepant commissarial decree-act, being cassated — in the competent forum, decided by the same action — himself the plaintiff to be freed from this legal claim; and by reason of the issued prejudicial decree — penalties against the party and likewise against the external court; and in the remainder all things that are of law, justice, and the documents — to be decided, decreed, and sentenced against you. Be prepared to attend to this citation and respond judicially. Given at Piotrków on the Saturday after Reminiscere Sunday in the Year of the Lord 1778.

The first — the Honest Szepczyński — in the town of Konin, at the house of the Honest Palszewicz, [...] with the mother of the household present; the second — the Honest Matuszkiewicz — against the Honourable Chełmski at the manor court of the estates of the village of Łukom, with [...] present — both copies on the tables of the heated rooms, distinctly, on today's day, as contained in the act, placed and left.

On behalf of the Honourable Prusimski against the Honourables Chełmski and the Kalisz Land Court — to the Tribunal — Relatio

To the office and present records of the Konin Municipal Court, appearing in person, the Honest Bartłomiej Szepczyński of the village of Trąbczyn and Mateusz Matuszkiewicz of the village of Szetlewek, Royal Court Summoners, General, sound of health, acknowledged the two authenticated citation letters issued for the ordinary general sessions of the Crown Tribunal of the Realm at Piotrków as described below, of the following tenor:

Stanislaus Augustus, by the Grace of God King of Poland, Grand Duke of Lithuania, of Russia, of Prussia, of Masovia, of Samogitia, of Kiev, et cetera, of Podolia, of Podlachia, of Livonia, of Smolensk, of Seversk, of Chernigov — to you, the Honourables: Stanisław Chełmski, hereditary owner of the estates of Łukomia; and Franciszek Wierusz Walknowski, Judge; Stefan Zielonacki, Deputy Judge; and Xawery Mikorski, Notary of the Kalisz Land Court — the judges complained of in the cause described below: regarding your persons, goods and office we command that in our Ordinary Courts of the Crown Tribunal of the Realm at Piotrków, from the date and service of the present citation, correctly within four weeks, or for as long as and whenever the present cause shall fall to be called and proclaimed for adjudication from the register and inscription belonging to it, you appear in person and peremptorily, at the instance of the Honourable Antoni of Kolno Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, hereditary owner of the estates of Trąbczyn, plaintiff;

who, adhering to his manifest made or to be made — and to the laws of the Realm and to the decrees both of the prior decree of your court of remission to the condescension term together with the succession of the widow of the plaintiff's late uncle, and to the Tribunal and to the Commission issued by the Estates of the Realm — cites you; or rather, staying the execution of your subsequent decree — issued at Konin on the Monday after the Feast of Saint Hedwig, Widow and Chosen of God, namely 20 October of the preceding year, between the Honourable Chełmski and himself the plaintiff — cites you to see and hear that the above-mentioned Konin Land Court decree, contrary to the prior decree — the prior decree neither reviewed nor resolved, and likewise unable to be resolved without a term which the Honourable Chełmski has not obtained — and with the Tribunal decree and the Commission issued by the Estates of the Realm, which obstruct and do not admit the Kalisz Land Court forum and your decision, not being attended to — having been issued prejudicially and also without the communication of documents due to be decreed according to the new statute of the law in so long-standing a cause begun thirty years ago — be reviewed; himself the plaintiff to be freed from its bond and rigour; nay rather, the cause for the resolution of that same decree to be remitted to the Tribunal;

and nonetheless — the transfer, or right, unlawfully acquired by the Honourable Chełmski from the Honest Jan Tracholz, unduly and for mere vexation and to entangle the boundary cause and the discrepant commissarial decree-act, being cassated — in the competent forum, decided by the same action — himself the plaintiff to be freed from this legal claim; and by reason of the issued prejudicial decree — penalties against the party and likewise against the external court; and in the remainder all things that are of law, justice, and the documents — to be decided, decreed, and sentenced against you. Be prepared to attend to this citation and respond judicially. Given at Piotrków on the Saturday after Reminiscere Sunday in the Year of the Lord 1778.

The first — the Honest Szepczyński — in the town of Konin, at the house of the Honest Palszewicz, [...] with the mother of the household present; the second — the Honest Matuszkiewicz — against the Honourable Chełmski at the manor court of the estates of the village of Łukom, with [...] present — both copies on the tables of the heated rooms, distinctly, on today's day, as contained in the act, placed and left.
summary_en: A report of the court messengers Bartłomiej Szepczyński of Trąbczyn and Mateusz Matuszkiewicz of Szetlewek of 30 March 1778. They have served two copies of a royal citation before the Crown Tribunal at Piotrków, dated at Piotrków on the Saturday after Reminiscere Sunday 1778. Cited are Stanisław Chełmski, heir of Łukomia, and the officers of the Kalisz land court: the judge Franciszek Wierusz Walknowski, the sub-judge Stefan Zielonacki and the notary Xawery Mikorski, at Prusimski's instance. The land court's decree of 20 October of the year before, said to contradict its earlier one, is to be lifted and the cause sent to the Tribunal; Prusimski asks to be freed from the claim that Chełmski acquired from Jan Tracholz. One copy was left at Konin in the house of the townsman Palszewicz, the other at the manor of Łukom.
summary_de: Bericht der Gerichtsboten Bartłomiej Szepczyński von Trąbczyn und Mateusz Matuszkiewicz von Szetlewek vom 30. März 1778. Sie haben zwei Ausfertigungen einer königlichen Ladung vor das Krontribunal in Petrikau zugestellt, ausgestellt in Petrikau am Samstag nach Reminiscere 1778. Geladen sind Stanisław Chełmski, Erbherr von Łukomia, und die Richter des Kalischer Landgerichts: der Richter Franciszek Wierusz Walknowski, der Unterrichter Stefan Zielonacki und der Notar Xawery Mikorski, auf Betreiben Prusimskis. Das Dekret des Landgerichts vom 20. Oktober des Vorjahres, das dem früheren widerspreche, soll aufgehoben und die Sache an das Tribunal verwiesen werden; Prusimski verlangt, von der Forderung befreit zu werden, die Chełmski von Jan Tracholz erworben hat. Eine Ausfertigung wurde in Konin im Haus des Bürgers Palszewicz hinterlegt, die andere im Gutshof von Łukom.
